subject.title: RFC 0024: Localization Runtime and Product Coverage

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this RFC’s shared localization runtime and product-wide coverage contract now, or first narrow it to a maintainer-owned foundation boundary?
rationale: The RFC introduces new feature, compatibility, governance, and release-policy commitments across several product surfaces; source review cannot choose the desired permanent product contract.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded foundation
options.body: Approve only the locale kernel, reviewed English fallback, and narrow adapter boundaries, while deferring wider coverage and release commitments.

options.title: Adopt the full contract
options.body: Approve the RFC’s product-wide direction and assign owners for Gateway metadata, recipient-locale selection, safety-copy review, language ownership, and release reporting.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep the RFC as a draft until product owners confirm that a shared localization contract is a current priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded foundation
recommendation.body: Approve only the locale kernel, reviewed English fallback, and narrow adapter boundaries, while deferring wider coverage and release commitments.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main RFC or localization owner could be established from the supplied context after the repository-inspection sandbox failed.
